title: 明挖覆蓋隧道施工
summary: 本課以整合明挖隧道的地表界面、支撐、水壓與回填階段為主線，從開挖尺度與地表影響與側向土壓與變形條件建立系統邊界，再把箱體自重與施工抗浮、支撐拆換與荷載轉移連到地表恢復與地下資產交接。開挖、結構施工與回填具有不同荷載路徑，竣工模型不能取代施工模型。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。
summaryEn: This course focuses on integrate surface interfaces, bracing, water pressure and backfilling in cut-and-cover tunnels. It begins with Excavation scale and surface impact and Lateral soil pressure and movement conditions, links Box weight and temporary flotation and Brace removal and load transfer, and ends with Surface restoration and underground handover. Excavation, structural work and backfilling have different load paths; the final model does not replace staged models. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「開挖尺度與地表影響」與「側向土壓與變形條件」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Excavation scale and surface impact" and "Lateral soil pressure and movement conditions": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 開挖尺度與地表影響：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Excavation scale and surface impact: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「開挖尺度與地表影響」如何影響明挖覆蓋隧道施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Excavation scale and surface impact” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Cut-and-cover tunnel construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 明挖把地下結構施工直接連到地表交通、管線和鄰房，開挖寬度也改變支撐跨距與土體卸載。土方體積只是物流量級，不能代表所有變形風險；工法選擇應把永久箱體、臨時圍護和地表使用需求放在同一斷面。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比對探測管線、道路分期及開挖邊界的共同座標；若出現只按土方安排忽略管線支承，既有設施因卸載或位移受損，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「開挖尺度與地表影響」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Cut-and-cover directly couples underground construction to traffic, utilities and neighbours. Width changes brace spans and unloading as well as spoil volume. Volume describes logistics rather than all deformation risks; compare the permanent box, temporary retention and surface-use demands in one section. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare detected utilities, road stages and excavation limits in shared coordinates. If a spoil-only plan misses utility support and damages services through unloading or movement, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Excavation scale and surface impact” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：V=L*B*H=100 m*14 m*8 m=11200 m3。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: V=L*B*H=100 m*14 m*8 m=11200 m3.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「土方體積相同就代表兩個明挖工程風險相同」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal excavation volume means identical risk for two cut-and-cover projects" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「開挖尺度與地表影響」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Excavation scale and surface impact”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 開挖尺度與地表影響
knowledge.text: 明挖把地下結構施工直接連到地表交通、管線和鄰房，開挖寬度也改變支撐跨距與土體卸載。土方體積只是物流量級，不能代表所有變形風險；工法選擇應把永久箱體、臨時圍護和地表使用需求放在同一斷面。
knowledge.textEn: Cut-and-cover directly couples underground construction to traffic, utilities and neighbours. Width changes brace spans and unloading as well as spoil volume.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：土方體積相同就代表兩個明挖工程風險相同 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal excavation volume means identical risk for two cut-and-cover projects Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「明挖覆蓋隧道施工」的「開挖尺度與地表影響：機制與系統路徑」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出地層、地下水、開挖邊界與支撐的介面，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「都會地下工區協調」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與地質假設、監測位置、時間順序及基準點版本的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Excavation scale and surface impact: mechanism and system paths” in “Cut-and-cover tunnel construction”. Draw the ground, groundwater, excavation boundary and support interfaces; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Urban underground coordination” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for ground assumptions, monitoring locations, time order and benchmark version, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「開挖尺度與地表影響」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Excavation scale and surface impact" is correct?
options: 土方體積相同就代表兩個明挖工程風險相同
明挖把地下結構施工直接連到地表交通、管線和鄰房，開挖寬度也改變支撐跨距與土體卸載。
所有擋土牆都可以直接使用完全主動土壓
optionsEn: Equal excavation volume means identical risk for two cut-and-cover projects
Cut-and-cover directly couples underground construction to traffic, utilities and neighbours.
Every retaining wall can directly use fully active earth pressure
quiz.explanation: 明挖把地下結構施工直接連到地表交通、管線和鄰房，開挖寬度也改變支撐跨距與土體卸載。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Cut-and-cover directly couples underground construction to traffic, utilities and neighbours. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 開挖尺度與地表影響：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Excavation scale and surface impact: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「開挖尺度與地表影響」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Excavation scale and surface impact” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：V=L*B*H=100 m*14 m*8 m=11200 m3。開挖、結構施工與回填具有不同荷載路徑，竣工模型不能取代施工模型。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: V=L*B*H=100 m*14 m*8 m=11200 m3. Excavation, structural work and backfilling have different load paths; the final model does not replace staged models. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比對探測管線、道路分期及開挖邊界的共同座標。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare detected utilities, road stages and excavation limits in shared coordinates.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：V=L*B*H=100 m*14 m*8 m=11200 m3。開挖、結構施工與回填具有不同荷載路徑，竣工模型不能取代施工模型。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: V=L*B*H=100 m*14 m*8 m=11200 m3. Excavation, structural work and backfilling have different load paths; the final model does not replace staged models. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「開挖尺度與地表影響」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Excavation scale and surface impact", which statement holds?
options: 基底往上動的所有原因都屬同一種失效
箱體牆面不裂就能保證所有穿牆位置都不漏
原創教學假設：V=L*B*H=100 m*14 m*8 m=11200 m3。
optionsEn: Every cause of upward base movement is the same failure mechanism
Uncracked box walls guarantee every penetration remains watertight
Original teaching assumptions: V=L*B*H=100 m*14 m*8 m=11200 m3.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：V=L*B*H=100 m*14 m*8 m=11200 m3。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: V=L*B*H=100 m*14 m*8 m=11200 m3. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 開挖尺度與地表影響：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Excavation scale and surface impact: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「開挖尺度與地表影響」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Excavation scale and surface impact” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比對探測管線、道路分期及開挖邊界的共同座標。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「只按土方安排忽略管線支承，既有設施因卸載或位移受損」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare detected utilities, road stages and excavation limits in shared coordinates. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A spoil-only plan misses utility support and damages services through unloading or movement. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將比對探測管線、道路分期及開挖邊界的共同座標列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現只按土方安排忽略管線支承，既有設施因卸載或位移受損，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare detected utilities, road stages and excavation limits in shared coordinates. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a spoil-only plan misses utility support and damages services through unloading or movement, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只按土方安排忽略管線支承，既有設施因卸載或位移受損。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A spoil-only plan misses utility support and damages services through unloading or movement. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比對探測管線、道路分期及開挖邊界的共同座標。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「只按土方安排忽略管線支承，既有設施因卸載或位移受損」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Compare detected utilities, road stages and excavation limits in shared coordinates. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A spoil-only plan misses utility support and damages services through unloading or movement. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將比對探測管線、道路分期及開挖邊界的共同座標列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現只按土方安排忽略管線支承，既有設施因卸載或位移受損，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Compare detected utilities, road stages and excavation limits in shared coordinates. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a spoil-only plan misses utility support and damages services through unloading or movement, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「開挖尺度與地表影響」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Excavation scale and surface impact"?
options: 比對探測管線、道路分期及開挖邊界的共同座標。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
平均沉陷很小就代表鄰房一定沒有損傷
optionsEn: Compare detected utilities, road stages and excavation limits in shared coordinates.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Small average settlement guarantees no damage to neighbouring buildings
quiz.explanation: 比對探測管線、道路分期及開挖邊界的共同座標。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare detected utilities, road stages and excavation limits in shared coordinates. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 開挖尺度與地表影響：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Excavation scale and surface impact: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「開挖尺度與地表影響」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Excavation scale and surface impact” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只按土方安排忽略管線支承，既有設施因卸載或位移受損。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比對探測管線、道路分期及開挖邊界的共同座標，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A spoil-only plan misses utility support and damages services through unloading or movement. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare detected utilities, road stages and excavation limits in shared coordinates to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察比對探測管線、道路分期及開挖邊界的共同座標；若出現只按土方安排忽略管線支承，既有設施因卸載或位移受損，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If a spoil-only plan misses utility support and damages services through unloading or movement, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「土方體積相同就代表兩個明挖工程風險相同」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal excavation volume means identical risk for two cut-and-cover projects" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只按土方安排忽略管線支承，既有設施因卸載或位移受損。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比對探測管線、道路分期及開挖邊界的共同座標，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: A spoil-only plan misses utility support and damages services through unloading or movement. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認

Every retaining wall can directly use fully active earth pressure
quiz.explanation: 只按土方安排忽略管線支承，既有設施因卸載或位移受損。 需以量測區分可能原因。

steps.title: 側向土壓與變形條件：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Lateral soil pressure and movement conditions: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「側向土壓與變形條件」如何影響明挖覆蓋隧道施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Lateral soil pressure and movement conditions” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Cut-and-cover tunnel construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 主動土壓需要足夠牆體位移才可動員，鄰房敏感區的剛性支撐未必允許達到這個狀態。地表超載與水壓應分開處理，不能將總壓力都乘同一係數；簡化三角分布只用來理解量級，支撐牆需考慮分階段受力。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將牆體測斜與土層、超載及水位狀態共同比對；若出現用主動壓力描述幾乎不動的牆，低估支撐反力，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「側向土壓與變形條件」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Active pressure requires sufficient wall movement, which stiff restraint near sensitive buildings may prevent. Treat surcharge and water separately rather than multiplying total pressure by one coefficient. A triangular diagram gives scale, while a supported wall needs staged force redistribution and movement compatibility. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare wall inclinometers with strata, surcharge and groundwater conditions. If active pressure applied to a nearly restrained wall understates brace reactions, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Lateral soil pressure and movement conditions” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：resultant=0.5*Ka*gamma*H^2=0.5*0.33*18 kN/m3*(8 m)^2=190.1 kN/m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: resultant=0.5*Ka*gamma*H^2=0.5*0.33*18 kN/m3*(8 m)^2=190.1 kN/m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「所有擋土牆都可以直接使用完全主動土壓」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Every retaining wall can directly use fully active earth pressure" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「側向土壓與變形條件」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

knowledge.textEn: Active pressure requires sufficient wall movement, which stiff restraint near sensitive buildings may prevent. Treat surcharge and water separately rather than multiplying total pressure by one coefficient.

steps.title: 側向土壓與變形條件：定量估算

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Lateral soil pressure and movement conditions” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：resultant=0.5*Ka*gamma*H^2=0.5*0.33*18 kN/m3*(8 m)^2=190.1 kN/m。開挖、結構施工與回填具有不同荷載路徑，竣工模型不能取代施工模型。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: resultant=0.5*Ka*gamma*H^2=0.5*0.33*18 kN/m3*(8 m)^2=190.1 kN/m. Excavation, structural work and backfilling have different load paths; the final model does not replace staged models. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將牆體測斜與土層、超載及水位狀態共同比對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare wall inclinometers with strata, surcharge and groundwater conditions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：resultant=0.5*Ka*gamma*H^2=0.5*0.33*18 kN/m3*(8 m)^2=190.1 kN/m。開挖、結構施工與回填具有不同荷載路徑，竣工模型不能取代施工模型。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。

Excavation, structural work and backfilling have different load paths; the final model does not replace staged models. knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 側向土壓與變形條件：試驗與驗證

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Lateral soil pressure and movement conditions” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將牆體測斜與土層、超載及水位狀態共同比對。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「用主動壓力描述幾乎不動的牆，低估支撐反力」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare wall inclinometers with strata, surcharge and groundwater conditions. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Active pressure applied to a nearly restrained wall understates brace reactions. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare wall inclinometers with strata, surcharge and groundwater conditions. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If active pressure applied to a nearly restrained wall understates brace reactions, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：用主動壓力描述幾乎不動的牆，低估支撐反力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Active pressure applied to a nearly restrained wall understates brace reactions. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
